searchText: EIP for the difficulty bomb delay, would be great if someone would sanity check the numbers independently 😄 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4345 I have a sort of noob question, is it possible to remove the diff bomb instead of delaying multiple times? When a EIP has to be made just to delay the bomb, it’s a bit of waste of time for the team isn’t it? The difficulty bomb's purpose (depending on who you ask) is to either: 1. Ensure that the client release systems in the ecosystem are continually exercised. 2. Ensure that if someone wants to continue running a PoW blockchain, they must have a functional client release system. I kind of answered that in the PR comments as well 😄 I like noob questions, because they cut through all the mental gymnastics in this community 🙂 We need more of those i'm a doctor and its a thing we constantly need to do, which is get rid of all the jargon we use, when discussing with patients. It often helps me to think about things more concretely also often the more ingrained in a subject you become and discuss with guys who are also in deep, conversations get taken over by jargon and acronyms and abreviations which make the whole thing more confusing usually, imo I like it, and shall choose to hold the opinion that it's both.

excerpts.author: shred209
excerpts.content: I have a sort of noob question, is it possible to remove the diff bomb instead of delaying multiple times? When a EIP has to be made just to delay the bomb, it’s a bit of waste of time for the team isn’t it?

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content:
The difficulty bomb's purpose (depending on who you ask) is to either:
1. Ensure that the client release systems in the ecosystem are continually exercised.
2. Ensure that if someone wants to continue running a PoW blockchain, they must have a functional client release system.
